subject: maths
question: A policeman notices a thief from a distance of 300 m. The thief starts running and the policeman chases him. The thief and the policeman run at the speeds of 10 km/h and 12 km/h, respectively. What will be the distance between them (in m) after 6 minutes?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed of policeman with respect to thief = 12 − 10 = 2 km/h.

Relative speed in m/min = (2 × 1000) ÷ 60 = 100/3 m/min.

Relative distance covered in 6 minutes = (100/3) × 6 = 200 m.

Remaining distance between them = Initial distance − Distance covered = 300 − 200 = 100 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 100 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance between Policeman and Thief = 300 m

Speed of Thief (Vₜ) = 10 km/h

Speed of Policeman (Vₚ) = 12 km/h

Time (t) = 6 minutes

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67017652b905e1ab2062f12dedf416887d74ecec82a8cbcd4837817a335490bf.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Relative Speed = Vₚ − Vₜ = 12 − 10 = 2 km/h

⇒ To convert km/h to m/s: 2 × (5/18) = 5/9 m/s

⇒ Time in seconds = 6 × 60 = 360 seconds

⇒ Relative distance covered in 6 min = Relative Speed × Time

⇒ Distance covered = (5/9) × 360 = 5 × 40 = 200 m

⇒ Distance between them after 6 min = Initial Gap − Relative distance covered

⇒ Remaining distance = 300 − 200 = 100 m

**∴ The correct answer is 100 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concept

When two objects move in the same direction, relative speed = S₁ − S₂. If they move in opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.

Speed Unit Conversion

To convert Speed from km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert from m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Catching Time Formula

Time taken to catch the thief = (Initial distance between them) ÷ (Relative Speed).</p
